10	# Tangent-space substrate: dual-number points of a scheme at a point (W5-T1, scheme layer)
11	
12	Scheme-level substrate for the Kleiman §5 tangent-space theorem (Wave-5 brick
13	T1, roadmap `AJCR.w5-av.t1`), bridging Mathlib's
14	`AlgebraicGeometry.SpecToEquivOfLocalRing` to the local-algebra substrate of
15	`Tangent/TangentDualNumbers.lean`.
16	
17	## Main declarations
18	
19	- `AlgebraicGeometry.isLocalHom_dualNumber_iff` — a ring homomorphism from a
20	  local ring to the dual numbers `k[ε]` over a field is a *local*
21	  homomorphism iff its constant component kills the maximal ideal. The
22	  right-hand side is exactly the side condition
23	  `∀ x ∈ maximalIdeal R, fst (f x) = 0` used throughout
24	  `TangentSpaceDualNumbers.lean`.
25	- `AlgebraicGeometry.specToEquivOfLocalRingAt` — the fiber form of Mathlib's
26	  `SpecToEquivOfLocalRing`: for a local ring `R` and a *fixed* point `x : X`,
27	  morphisms `Spec R ⟶ X` sending the closed point to `x` correspond to local
28	  ring homomorphisms `𝒪_{X,x} ⟶ R`.
29	- `AlgebraicGeometry.specDualNumberAtEquiv` — the two combined: dual-number
30	  points of `X` at `x` correspond to ring homomorphisms `𝒪_{X,x} → k[ε]`
31	  whose constant component kills the maximal ideal.
32	
33	Combined with `localDualNumberHomEquivCotangentSpaceDual`
34	(`Tangent/TangentDualNumbers.lean`), this identifies the dual-number points of
35	`X` at a `k`-rational point `x` with the dual of the cotangent space
36	`m_x/m_x²`, once the `k`-algebra structure on the stalk (from the structure
37	morphism of a `k`-scheme) is threaded through — done in
38	`Tangent/TangentStalkAlgebra.lean`.
39	
40	## Provenance (W5-T1 port, cross-project)
41	
42	Ported from `Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge`,
43	`AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/TangentSpaceSchemePoints.lean` (sorry-free, stated
44	in mathlib generality); see the provenance note of
45	`Tangent/TangentDualNumbers.lean` and inbox `I-0495` overlap #2. The import
46	list is trimmed to what the declarations actually use (the source carried four

70	    IsLocalHom f ↔ ∀ x ∈ maximalIdeal R, fst (f x) = 0 := by
71	  constructor
72	  · intro hf x hx
73	    by_contra h0
74	    have hu : IsUnit (f x) := isUnit_iff_isUnit_fst.mpr (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr h0)
75	    exact mem_nonunits_iff.mp ((mem_maximalIdeal x).mp hx) (hf.map_nonunit x hu)
76	  · intro h
77	    refine ⟨fun a ha => ?_⟩
78	    by_contra hna
79	    have hm : a ∈ maximalIdeal R := (mem_maximalIdeal a).mpr (mem_nonunits_iff.mpr hna)
80	    have h0 : fst (f a) = 0 := h a hm
81	    have := isUnit_iff_isUnit_fst.mp ha
82	    rw [h0] at this
83	    exact not_isUnit_zero this
84	
85	end DualNumberLocalHom

90	
91	/-- **Fiber form of `SpecToEquivOfLocalRing`.** For a local ring `R`, a scheme
92	`X` and a fixed point `x : X`, morphisms `Spec R ⟶ X` sending the closed
93	point to `x` correspond to local ring homomorphisms `𝒪_{X,x} ⟶ R`. -/

95	    {f : Spec R ⟶ X // f.base (closedPoint R) = x} ≃
96	      {φ : X.presheaf.stalk x ⟶ R // IsLocalHom φ.hom} where
97	  toFun f :=
98	    ⟨(X.presheaf.stalkCongr (Inseparable.of_eq f.2.symm)).hom ≫
99	        Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo f.1,
100	     haveI : IsLocalHom ((X.presheaf.stalkCongr
101	         (Inseparable.of_eq f.2.symm)).hom).hom := isLocalHom_of_isIso _
102	     CommRingCat.isLocalHom_comp _ _⟩
103	  invFun φ :=
104	    haveI := φ.2
105	    ⟨Spec.map φ.1 ≫ X.fromSpecStalk x, by
106	      rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, Spec_closedPoint, Scheme.fromSpecStalk_closedPoint]⟩
107	  left_inv := by
108	    rintro ⟨f, rfl⟩
109	    refine Subtype.ext ?_
110	    dsimp only
111	    have hcongr : (X.presheaf.stalkCongr
112	        (Inseparable.of_eq (rfl : f.base (closedPoint R) = f.base (closedPoint R)).symm)).hom
113	          = 𝟙 _ := by
114	      simp [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkCongr]
115	    rw [hcongr, Category.id_comp]
116	    exact Scheme.Spec_stalkClosedPointTo_fromSpecStalk f
117	  right_inv := by
118	    rintro ⟨φ, hφ⟩
119	    haveI := hφ
120	    refine Subtype.ext ?_
121	    dsimp only
122	    refine TopCat.Presheaf.stalk_hom_ext _ fun U hxU ↦ ?_
123	    simp only [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkCongr_hom, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes_assoc,

141	    {f : Spec (CommRingCat.of (DualNumber k)) ⟶ X //

143	      {φ : X.presheaf.stalk x ⟶ CommRingCat.of (DualNumber k) //
